title: Contract Pricing Agreement Rebate Forfeiture Figure on Early Termination
content:
Rebate administration — forfeiture figure on an early termination (Contract Pricing Agreement)

**1. Agreement in view.** The agreement's status is terminated after the customer's early termination, its tier forfeits rebate on early termination, and the termination effective date (the agreement's closing date) falls on one of the 92 days before the date of the agreement's latest rebate accrual, so that the latest accrued rebate period is the period in which the termination took effect (the termination period).

**2. Net rebate of the termination period.** The termination period's net rebate is the rebate accrued for the termination period less every payout and every reversal already booked against that period, as the agreement's rebate ledger shows them.

**3. Forfeiture.** The forfeiture is the termination period's net rebate; it is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure. The reliefs set for the forfeiture are added together and subtracted once from the termination period's net rebate before that floor and that rounding are applied.

**4. Counting.** Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one. Wherever a latest record of a kind is taken, it is the one with the latest date, and among records of the same date the one recorded first.

| Termination effective date, counted back from the latest accrual date | In view under 1 |
|---|---|
| Same day as the accrual | No |
| 1 day before | Yes |
| 92 days before | Yes |
| 93 days before | No |

**Worked figure (hypothetical ledger).** Termination period accrual 3000.00; no payout against that period; one reversal of 200.00 against it. Net rebate: 3000.00 less 0.00 less 200.00, which is 2800.00. Forfeiture: 2800.00.
